Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application (secure, production-ready)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name (e.g., prod, staging)
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the database
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of private subnet IDs in at least two AZs
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: Security Group ID of the application that needs DB access
  DBClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-aurora-pg
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: DB cluster identifier
  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: appdb
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Initial database name
  DBEngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '15.4'
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version compatible with Serverless v2 (e.g., 15.4)
  DBFamily:
    Type: String
    Default: aurora-postgresql15
    Description: DB parameter group family matching the major engine version (e.g., aurora-postgresql15)
  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum ACU for Serverless v2
  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum ACU for Serverless v2
  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Number of days to retain automated backups
  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 03:00-04:00
    Description: Daily backup window UTC (hh24:mi-hh24:mi)
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: sun:06:00-sun:07:00
    Description: Weekly maintenance window UTC (ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi)
  RotationDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Secrets Manager automatic rotation interval in days
  CloudwatchLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: Retention in days for RDS CloudWatch log groups
  LogExports:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: postgresql,upgrade
    Description: Comma-separated list of log types to export to CloudWatch Logs (e.g., postgresql,upgrade)
  DeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true','false']
    Description: Enable deletion protection on the cluster

Mappings: {}

Resources:
  RDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL data, Performance Insights, Secrets, and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:rds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:*
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}*

  RDSKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}/rds/aurora-postgresql
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  RotationLambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Secrets Manager rotation lambda
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-rotation-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBSGIngressFromApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow application access to Aurora PostgreSQL

  DBSGIngressFromRotation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref RotationLambdaSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Secrets Manager rotation lambda to access DB

  DBSGSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow intra-cluster traffic

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      SubnetIds: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-subnets
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-subnets
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Cluster parameter group enforcing SSL and useful telemetry
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-cluster-params
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostgresqlLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}/postgresql
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudwatchLogRetentionDays

  UpgradeLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}/upgrade
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudwatchLogRetentionDays

  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-monitoring
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBClusterIdentifier
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref DBEngineVersion
      DatabaseName: !Ref DBName
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      Port: 5432
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUserSecret:
        KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports: !Ref LogExports
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      DeletionProtection: !Ref DeletionProtection
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-cluster
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-writer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-reader
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBSecretRotationSchedule:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule
    Properties:
      SecretId: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
      HostedRotationLambda:
        RotationType: PostgreSQLSingleUser
        VpcSecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref RotationLambdaSecurityGroup
        VpcSubnetIds: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      RotationRules:
        AutomaticallyAfterDays: !Ref RotationDays

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterEndpoint
  DBReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBReaderEndpoint
  DBSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the master user credentials
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecretArn
  DatabaseSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID used by the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application (secure, production-ready)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name (e.g., prod, staging)
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the database
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of private subnet IDs in at least two AZs
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: Security Group ID of the application that needs DB access
  DBClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-aurora-pg
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: DB cluster identifier
  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: appdb
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Initial database name
  DBEngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '15.4'
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version compatible with Serverless v2 (e.g., 15.4)
  DBFamily:
    Type: String
    Default: aurora-postgresql15
    Description: DB parameter group family matching the major engine version (e.g., aurora-postgresql15)
  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum ACU for Serverless v2
  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum ACU for Serverless v2
  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Number of days to retain automated backups
  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 03:00-04:00
    Description: Daily backup window UTC (hh24:mi-hh24:mi)
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: sun:06:00-sun:07:00
    Description: Weekly maintenance window UTC (ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi)
  RotationDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Secrets Manager automatic rotation interval in days
  CloudwatchLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: Retention in days for RDS CloudWatch log groups
  LogExports:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: postgresql,upgrade
    Description: Comma-separated list of log types to export to CloudWatch Logs (e.g., postgresql,upgrade)
  DeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true','false']
    Description: Enable deletion protection on the cluster

Mappings: {}

Resources:
  RDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL data, Performance Insights, Secrets, and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:rds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:*
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}*

  RDSKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}/rds/aurora-postgresql
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  RotationLambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Secrets Manager rotation lambda
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-rotation-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBSGIngressFromApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow application access to Aurora PostgreSQL

  DBSGIngressFromRotation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref RotationLambdaSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Secrets Manager rotation lambda to access DB

  DBSGSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow intra-cluster traffic

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      SubnetIds: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-subnets
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-subnets
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Cluster parameter group enforcing SSL and useful telemetry
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-cluster-params
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostgresqlLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}/postgresql
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudwatchLogRetentionDays

  UpgradeLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${DBClusterIdentifier}/upgrade
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudwatchLogRetentionDays

  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-monitoring
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-monitoring
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBClusterIdentifier
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref DBEngineVersion
      DatabaseName: !Ref DBName
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      Port: 5432
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUserSecret:
        KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports: !Ref LogExports
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      DeletionProtection: !Ref DeletionProtection
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-cluster
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-writer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-pg-reader
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBSecretRotationSchedule:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule
    Properties:
      SecretId: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
      HostedRotationLambda:
        RotationType: PostgreSQLSingleUser
        VpcSecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref RotationLambdaSecurityGroup
        VpcSubnetIds: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      RotationRules:
        AutomaticallyAfterDays: !Ref RotationDays

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterEndpoint
  DBReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBReaderEndpoint
  DBSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the master user credentials
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecretArn
  DatabaseSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID used by the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId
